name: Eulerian Analytics
author: Eulerian Technologies

sections.description:
Connects Eulerian Analytics to WordPress
Easily add Eulerian Analytics to your web pages

This plugin enables Eulerian Analytics for your entire WordPress site. Lightweight and fast with plenty of great features.

Enable Eulerian Analytics

Steps to enable Eulerian Analytics :

  1. Follow this guide to create a free Eulerian Analytics account
  2. During account creation, you’ll get a tracking domain
  3. Add your new tracking domain to the plugin setting, “Eulerian Analytics Tracking”

Save changes and done. Wait a couple of minutes before viewing collected data in your Eulerian Analytics account.

Feature Support

  • Supports Page Tracking
  • Supports Transaction Tracking if WooCommerce is installed
  • Supports Lead Tracking if ContactForm7 is installed

General Features

  • Blazing fast performance
  • Does one thing and does it well
  • Drop-dead simple and easy to use
  • Regularly updated and “future proof”
  • Stays current with the latest tracking code
  • Includes tracking code in footer
  • Includes tracking code on all WordPress web pages

This is a lightweight plugin that inserts the required Eulerian Analytics tracking code. To view your site statistics, visit your Eulerian Analytics account.

Privacy

Please visit Privacy Center in Eulerian Analytics to configure privacy
management and data collection level depending on your specific compliance &
privacy rules.

External services

This plugin connects to Eulerian Analytics servers hosted by Eulerian
Technologies to allow to provide the service of our Eulerian Marketing Platform
:

  • Eulerian Marketing Platform provides web analytics, customer behaviour, marketing analytics, user segment segmentation and data activation services for the advertiser implementing the service.
  • Page views, Leads (contact form through ContactForm7) and transactions are
    collected by the plugin and set to the Eulerian Marketing Platform to provide
    the Eulerian Analytics service. The following data is collected :
    o Page views : page url + customerId if the user is loggued in
    o Leads : Contact Form Id as provided by ContactForm7
    o Transactions : Order reference, amount, payment type, products sold (sku,name, price, quantity), currency.
  • The data collected on behalf of the advertiser is solely owned by the advertiser and not by Eulerian Technologies.

Privacy policy

General Terms & Conditions
sections.installation:
How to install the plugin

  1. Upload the plugin to your blog and activate
  2. Visit the settings to configure your options

After configuring your settings, you can verify that Eulerian Analytics tracking code is included by viewing the source code of your web pages.

More info on installing WP plugins »

How to use the plugin

To enable Eulerian Analytics tracking on your site, follow these steps:

  1. Follow this guide to create a free Eulerian Analytics account
  2. During account creation, you’ll get a tracking domain
  3. Add your new tracking domain to the plugin setting, “Eulerian Analytics Tracking”

Save changes and done. After a couple of minutes, you can log into your Eulerian Analytics account and view your site statistics.

Restore Default Options

To restore default plugin options, either uninstall/reinstall the plugin, or visit the plugin settings > Restore Default Options.

Uninstalling

Eulerian Analytics cleans up after itself. All plugin settings will be removed
from your database when the plugin is uninstalled via the Plugins screen. Your collected Eulerian Analytics data will remain in your Eulerian account.

Like the plugin?

If you like Eulerian Analytics, please take a moment to give a 5-star rating. It helps to keep development and support going strong. Thank you!
sections.faq:
How to enable Eulerian Analytics ?

Check out the top of this page, first section provides the steps to add Eulerian Analytics to your site.

Tracking code is not displayed in source code?

If you check the source code of your pages and don’t see the Eulerian Analytics tracking code, check the following:

  • Check that your theme includes the hooks wp_footer
  • If you are using a caching plugin, try clearing the cache

If the Eulerian Analytics tracking code still is not displayed, most likely there is interference from another plugin or theme. In this case, the best way to resolve the issue is to do some basic WordPress troubleshooting.

Got a question?

To ask a question, suggest a feature, or provide feedback, contact me
directly. Learn more about Eulerian Analytics.
